reviewer: parent assistant full-source review; not clinician adjudication
scope: Selected semantic disagreements; not an exhaustive re-adjudication of continuation flags
raw_summary_policy: Keep Luna descriptive counts separate; these dispositions supersede the specified raw classifications for parent interpretation.

source_quotes: Physical examination revealed splenomegaly, although the patient was asymptomatic.
records.explanation: Splenomegaly already appears in symptoms and physical examination. Failure to repeat it in the imaging leaf alone is not established as a material case-level omission.

source_quotes: Patient was discharged same day and aspirin and Plavix were resumed.
records.explanation: After-discharge wording is more precise than the source, but a conjunction and sentence order make that sequence plausible. Preserve uncertainty about timing instead of counting a definite discrepancy.

source_quotes: From the age of 16 the boy
After bowel disimpaction, the condition was treated with daily BM with Peristeen® transanal irrigation.
After 3 years, for lack of symptoms improvement
records.explanation: The current age19 and three-year treatment course support an approximate age16 start. Exact onset is not explicit, but this is plausible chronology, not an established transferred-time error.

source_quotes: There was no cancer invasion on both sides and metastatic carcinoma in the mesenteric lymph nodes.
records.label_excerpt: no metastatic carcinoma in the mesenteric lymph nodes
records.explanation: Source negation scope is awkward and ambiguous, whereas the label decisively negates nodal metastasis. Preserve ambiguity and flag for clinical adjudication; do not use outside staging knowledge to silently rewrite it.
